t: The Bedrock and the Dazzle: Building Timeless Tools in an Age of Tech Churn
s: This article reflects on the ephemeral nature of past tech successes, advocating for building 'future-proof' tools with stable technologies by shifting focus from fleeting trends to robust, reproducible workflows and timeless craftsmanship.
sub: Critique of tech industry churn vs. craftsman skill
Evolution and limitations of SEO data access (e.g., 'not provided')
The challenge of building enduring, simple software solutions
Philosophy of future-proofing through stable tech choices (Python, Nix)
Comparison of web browser UIs vs. native GUIs for local apps
